The '''Denon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denon/Legends|Denon]].
